results.question: How many subsea cable systems are in the graph?
results.cypher:
MATCH (c:CableSystem)
RETURN count(c) AS total_cable_systems
LIMIT 1

results.question: Which countries does the Dunant cable land in?
results.cypher:
MATCH (s:LandingStation)-[:LANDS]->(c:CableSystem)
WHERE toLower(c.name) CONTAINS 'dunant'
RETURN DISTINCT s.country_name AS country, s.country AS country_code
ORDER BY country
LIMIT 25

results.question: In what year did MAREA enter service?
results.cypher:
MATCH (c:CableSystem)
WHERE toLower(c.name) CONTAINS 'marea'
RETURN c.name AS cable_name, c.ready_for_service AS rfs_year
LIMIT 25

results.question: Who owns the Amitie cable?

expected.owners: EXA Infrastructure, Meta, Microsoft, Orange, Vodafone

results.cypher:
MATCH (c:CableSystem)
WHERE toLower(c.name) CONTAINS 'amitie'
RETURN c.name AS cable_name, c.owners AS owners
LIMIT 25

answer.owners: EXA Infrastructure, Meta, Microsoft, Orange, Vodafone

results.question: How many GPUs are in the Dublin campus?
results.cypher:
MATCH (g:GPU {campus: 'DUB'})
RETURN count(g) AS dublin_gpu_count
LIMIT 25

results.question: Which country has the most landing stations?
results.cypher:
MATCH (s:LandingStation)
WHERE s.country_name IS NOT NULL
RETURN s.country_name AS country, count(s) AS landing_station_count
ORDER BY landing_station_count DESC
LIMIT 1

results.question: What is the longest subsea cable?
results.cypher:
MATCH (c:CableSystem)
WHERE c.length_km IS NOT NULL
RETURN c.name AS cable_name, c.length_km AS length_km, c.ready_for_service AS rfs_year
ORDER BY c.length_km DESC
LIMIT 1

results.question: How many cables entered service in 2020?
results.cypher:
MATCH (c:CableSystem)
WHERE c.ready_for_service = 2020
RETURN count(c) AS cables_entered_service_2020
LIMIT 25

results.question: Which landing station has the most cables landing at it?
results.cypher:
MATCH (s:LandingStation)-[:LANDS]->(c:CableSystem)
RETURN s.name AS station_name, s.code AS station_code, s.country_name AS country, count(c) AS cable_count
ORDER BY cable_count DESC
LIMIT 1

results.question: What is the total design capacity in Tbps of all cables that land in Ireland?
results.cypher:
MATCH (s:LandingStation {country_name: 'Ireland'})-[:LANDS]->(c:CableSystem)
RETURN sum(DISTINCT c.design_capacity_tbps) AS total_design_capacity_tbps
LIMIT 1

results.question: Which cables carry the primary gradient sync tunnel tun_iad_dub_pri?
results.cypher:
MATCH (t:LogicalTunnel {id: 'tun_iad_dub_pri'})-[:CARRIED_BY]->(c:CableSystem)
RETURN c.id AS cable_id, c.name AS cable_name, c.design_capacity_tbps AS capacity_tbps, c.ready_for_service AS rfs_year
LIMIT 25

results.question: Which training jobs depend on the Dunant cable?
results.cypher:
MATCH (j:TrainingJob)-[:COORDINATES]->(r:NCCL_Ring)-[:USES_TUNNEL]->(t:LogicalTunnel)-[:CARRIED_BY]->(c:CableSystem)
WHERE toLower(c.name) CONTAINS 'dunant'
RETURN DISTINCT j.id AS job_id, j.name AS job_name, j.gpu_count AS gpu_count, j.priority AS priority, c.name AS cable_name
ORDER BY j.priority DESC, j.name ASC
LIMIT 25

results.question: Which traffic classes ride the Pan European Crossing (UK-Ireland) cable?
results.cypher:
MATCH (t:LogicalTunnel)-[:CARRIED_BY]->(c:CableSystem)
WHERE toLower(c.name) CONTAINS 'pan european crossing' AND toLower(c.name) CONTAINS 'uk-ireland'
RETURN DISTINCT t.traffic_class AS traffic_class, c.name AS cable_name
LIMIT 25

results.question: Which other cables share a risk group (SRLG) with Dunant?
results.cypher:
MATCH (target:CableSystem)
WHERE toLower(target.name) CONTAINS 'dunant'
MATCH ()-[s1:OPTICAL_SPAN]->()
WHERE s1.cable_id = target.id AND s1.srlg_id IS NOT NULL
MATCH ()-[s2:OPTICAL_SPAN]->()
WHERE s2.srlg_id = s1.srlg_id AND s2.cable_id <> target.id
MATCH (other:CableSystem {id: s2.cable_id})
RETURN DISTINCT other.name AS shared_cable, s1.srlg_id AS srlg_id
LIMIT 25

results.question: How many GPUs are members of the NCCL rings coordinated by the Llama-4 400B job?
results.cypher:
MATCH (j:TrainingJob)-[:COORDINATES]->(r:NCCL_Ring)<-[:MEMBER_OF]-(g:GPU)
WHERE toLower(j.name) CONTAINS 'llama-4' AND toLower(j.name) CONTAINS '400b'
RETURN j.name AS job_name, count(DISTINCT g) AS gpu_count
LIMIT 25

results.question: Which data halls contain servers whose GPUs belong to ring ring_iad_dub_01?
results.cypher:
MATCH (r:NCCL_Ring {id: 'ring_iad_dub_01'})<-[:MEMBER_OF]-(g:GPU)<-[:ATTACHED_TO]-(:NIC)<-[:HAS_NIC]-(s:Server)-[:IN_RACK]->(:Rack)-[:IN_ROW]->(:Row)-[:IN_HALL]->(dh:DataHall)
RETURN DISTINCT dh.id AS data_hall_id, dh.campus AS campus, count(DISTINCT s) AS server_count, count(DISTINCT g) AS gpu_count
ORDER BY dh.id ASC
LIMIT 25

results.question: Which NCCL rings send their traffic over gradient sync tunnels?
results.cypher:
MATCH (r:NCCL_Ring)-[:USES_TUNNEL]->(t:LogicalTunnel)
WHERE toLower(t.traffic_class) CONTAINS 'gradient'
RETURN r.id AS ring_id, r.ring_index AS ring_index, t.id AS tunnel_id, t.traffic_class AS traffic_class, t.state AS tunnel_state
LIMIT 25

results.question: Which training jobs would be hit if every cable landing in France failed?
results.cypher:
MATCH (s:LandingStation {country_name: 'France'})-[:LANDS]->(c:CableSystem)<-[:CARRIED_BY]-(t:LogicalTunnel)<-[:USES_TUNNEL]-(r:NCCL_Ring)<-[:COORDINATES]-(j:TrainingJob)
RETURN DISTINCT j.name AS job_name, j.model_params AS model_params, j.gpu_count AS gpu_count, j.priority AS priority, c.name AS affected_cable
ORDER BY j.priority DESC, j.gpu_count DESC
LIMIT 25

results.question: How many racks are in the Ashburn campus data halls?
results.cypher:
MATCH (rack:Rack)-[:IN_ROW]->(:Row)-[:IN_HALL]->(:DataHall)-[:IN_CAMPUS]->(s:LandingStation {code: 'IAD'})
RETURN count(DISTINCT rack) AS ashburn_rack_count
LIMIT 25

results.question: Which cable has the highest planet-scan risk?
results.cypher:
MATCH (c:CableSystem)
WHERE c.scan_risk IS NOT NULL
RETURN c.name AS cable_name, c.scan_risk AS scan_risk, c.scan_rank AS scan_rank, c.scan_gpus_at_risk AS gpus_at_risk, c.scan_isolated_stations AS isolated_stations
ORDER BY c.scan_risk DESC
LIMIT 1

results.question: How many times has the Dunant cable failed before, according to incident memory?
results.cypher:
MATCH (i:Incident)-[:SEVERED]->(c:CableSystem)
WHERE toLower(c.name) CONTAINS 'dunant'
RETURN c.name AS cable_name, count(i) AS failure_count
LIMIT 25

results.question: Which cables have past incidents rerouted traffic onto?
results.cypher:
MATCH (i:Incident)-[:REROUTED_VIA]->(c:CableSystem)
RETURN DISTINCT c.id AS cable_id, c.name AS cable_name, count(i) AS incidents_rerouted_onto
ORDER BY incidents_rerouted_onto DESC
LIMIT 25

results.question: What is the lowest possible latency in ms between the IAD and DUB gateways over optical spans?
results.cypher:
MATCH (src:LandingStation {code: 'IAD'}), (dst:LandingStation {code: 'DUB'})
CALL algo.SPpaths({sourceNode: src, targetNode: dst, relTypes: ['OPTICAL_SPAN'], weightProp: 'latency_ms', pathCount: 1})
YIELD path, pathWeight
RETURN pathWeight AS lowest_latency_ms, [n IN nodes(path) | n.code] AS route_stations
LIMIT 1
